title: Singapore-US Cooperation under Biden Administration and Assessment of Relations under New Trump Administration
what_it_is: Singapore-US Cooperation under Biden Administration and Assessment of Relations under New Trump Administration

sections.label: Singapore-US ties questions
sections.summary: Questions ask about Singapore-US ties under Biden, key achievements, building ties under Trump, US engagement in Asia Pacific, and US-China ties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Neil Parekh Nimil Rajnikant
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Foreign Affairs (a) whether an assessment of Singapore-US bilateral ties under the Biden administration can be given; (b) what are the key achievements of Singapore-US relations during the tenure of the Biden government; (c) how will Singapore continue building on ties with the US under President Trump; (d) why does US engagement in the Asia Pacific remain critical for the region’s prosperity, security and growth; and (e) how does Singapore envisage US-China ties under the new Trump administration.

sections.label: USSFTA and US investment
sections.summary: The USSFTA tripled bilateral trade since 2004, the US maintains a trade surplus, and US FDI in Singapore exceeds cumulative investment in China, India, Japan and Korea.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The USSFTA contributed to the tripling of bilateral trade since 2004 and has allowed the US to consistently maintain a trade surplus with Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: In fact, if you add up the stock of US foreign direct investment (FDI) into Singapore, the US has invested more in Singapore than it has invested cumulatively in China, India, Japan and Korea combined.

sections.label: FTAs with Pacific Alliance, Mercosur
sections.summary: Singapore has signed FTAs with the Pacific Alliance and with Mercosur.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: You would also have noticed that we have now signed FTAs with the Pacific Alliance, which is Mexico, Colombia, Peru and Chile, and we also signed one with Mercosur, which is Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay.

sections.label: ASEAN-US Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
sections.summary: ASEAN and the US elevated relations to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in 2022 and adopted Leaders' statements on the ASEAN Outlook on the Indo-Pacific and artificial intelligence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: With the US, ASEAN and the US elevated relations to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in 2022 and we were able to adopt a Leaders’ level statement on cooperation on the ASEAN Outlook on the Indo-Pacific as well as on artificial intelligence.

sections.label: Tariffs and Singapore economy
sections.summary: Tariffs are a reality going forward, Singapore is not anticipated to be on the direct tariff hit list, but as a small open economy it will be indirectly impacted by trade friction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: But just take a step back, I think tariffs and emerging tariffs are a reality going forward.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: I will take some risk and say that I do not anticipate us being on the hit list for direct tariffs because, as I said earlier in my answer, the US has a surplus in as far as the trade balance with us is concerned.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Having said that, even if you assume that there are no tariffs, no direct tariffs against the export of Singapore products and services, the fact that we are a small open economy and that trade constitutes more than three times our gross domestic product means if there is any friction, if there is any degradation of economic integration global supply chains and world trade, we will be impacted indirectly.
